articles.title: Desde Tucumán, Milei llamó a los gobernadores a 'sentar las bases para el futuro de una verdadera libertad'
articles.summary: President Milei addressed governors in Tucumán on July 8-9, highlighting his administration's achievements over two years including fiscal surplus, debt reduction, and security reforms, while calling for support on pending legislative priorities including electoral reform and Central Bank charter modifications.

articles.title: Tedeum, en vivo: ante Milei, García Cuerva defendió la inversión en discapacidad y pidió dejar atrás la 'mezquindad política'
articles.summary: President Milei participated in the July 9 Independence Day Te Deum ceremony at the Metropolitan Cathedral, where the archbishop called for unity and criticized political divisiveness, while Milei prioritizes Central Bank charter reform as his key legislative objective.

articles.title: Ahora juega la casta: Javier Milei movió primero y fuerte para 2027
articles.summary: The government is accelerating electoral strategy and legislative efforts to support Milei's 2027 reelection bid, including negotiations with governors to eliminate primary elections (PASO) and building party infrastructure with internal polling showing challenges.

articles.title: Javier Milei puso la Casa Rosada a disposición de la Selección y prometió no estar presente el día que la visiten
articles.summary: President Milei offered the Casa Rosada to the Argentine national soccer team for potential World Cup celebrations while working on Central Bank reform, capital markets reforms, and discussing inflation reduction strategy in a radio interview.

articles.title: El efusivo canto de la Marcha de San Lorenzo que hizo Javier Milei junto a un granadero
articles.summary: President Milei participated in the July 9 Independence Day Te Deum ceremony and enthusiastically sang the San Lorenzo March with the National Guard while walking from the Cathedral to Casa Rosada.
